notes.title: Update 1.37: Final Boss Mechanic Change, QoL, Bugs
notes.content:
Update 1.37: Final Boss Mechanic Change, QoL, Bugs
[list]
[*] Balancing: Final boss 1 mechanic drastically changed, now has phase-dependent invincibility instead of damage reflect
[*] Balancing: Final boss 2 HP reduced by about 10%
[*] Balancing: Pinball side job 2 defense slightly easier with less enemies
[*] QoL: Job-giving NPCs now have exactly positioned markers on the map while job is ready or done
[*] QoL: Active job markers on the map now have a circular animation to clarify that they only mark the room but do not show the exact position
[*] QoL: Therematron shield direction improved, with gamepad keeps facing the last firing direction for a couple of seconds, with mouse and keyboard always faces mouse cursor
[*] QoL: Barriers in Pinball racing room are now open while the job is not active, though there is nothing of interest in that room
[*] Bugfix: Removed needless and faulty barrier in Computer Space Bar in front of the teleporter leading to the last port station
[*] Bugfix: Fixed erroneous triggering of a cutscene when entering Top Level Management in Tek Tek Inc
[*] Bugfix: Chiptune module no longer has an initial firing delay when switching to it during gameplay
[*] Text: Computer side job 3 dialog text gives a hint to the riddle number
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.36: Balancing, QoL, Bugs
notes.content:
Update 1.36: Balancing, QoL, Bugs
Includes the same changes from 1.35. Correction for missing to mention the balancing change.
[list]
[*] Balancing: Final Boss HP reduced by 30% and attack delays reduced a little
[*] QoL: Job Menu now displays the NPC name in yellow for main jobs and in blue for optional side jobs
[*] Bugfix: Level fix in SynthWorld where a barrier could be bypassed
[*] Text: Added dialogs for clarification when approaching the first barriers in Synthetia before finishing the first job
[*] Text: Text corrections and minor clarifications
[/list]

notes.title: Look Mum No Computer will launch July 24!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544541/8a2c9c45e33de7176344856b047a1e54b348ad08.png"][/img]

Hi there again, Krazy Kosmo-nauts!

Get yourself ready for some retro twin-stick adventure action! It’s finally time to crank up the volume and wield your synthesizer to fight evil on [b][i][u]July 24[/u][/i][/b]!

[b]Look Mum No Computer[/b] takes you to the quirky, pixel-art universe of Soldersworth. Join Sam and his synthesizer sidekick, Kosmo, as you battle rogue machines and fix them from the inside — one electrifying beat at a time!

Until release, you can take a look at our demo if you haven't played it yet. It is packed with juicy pixel art, banging tracks, and a bunch of modules to customize your own synth-weapon. Explore one action-packed level, battle a bosse at the end of the stage, and save the world with the power of music!

Have fun and talk to you soon!
The Bitfather & Headup

Once again, it's about time for the fabulous Steam Next Fest! Until June 16 an endlessly large number of demos are live here on Steam, connected to hundreds of streams, developer specials, and much more. Exciting times for sure, and you definitely don't want to miss out!

And [b]Look Mum No Computer[/b] is part of the Next Fest circus as well: Our demo is packed with juicy pixel art, banging tracks by artist and content creator Look Mum No Computer, and a bunch of modules to customize your own synth-weapon. Explore one action-packed level, battle a boss at the end of the stage, and save the world with the power of music!

We really hope you will enjoy playing our demo! If you're having a good time, please do us a favor and click on "[i]Follow[/i]" as well as on "[i]Add To Your Wishlist[/i]". If you want to give us feedback on the demo (highly appreciated!), please leave your feedback in the comments or the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3400380"]Steam Community Hub[/url]. That would really help us a lot!

Happy Steam Next Fest to all of you!

Greetings again, Krazy Kosmo-nauts!

Right in time for Steam Next Fest we have some good news for you: [b]Look Mum No Compute[/b]r was reviewed and got verified for the Steam Deck!

Have fun and talk to you soon!
